query: SELECT ca.id, ca.customerId, ca.currentBalanceUsd, ca.currentBalanceIqd, c.fullName FROM customerAccounts ca JOIN customers c ON ca.customerId = c.id WHERE ca.currentBalanceUsd != '0.00' OR ca.currentBalanceIqd != '0' LIMIT 10;
